premises.text: The Bright Context platform provides a cloud-based solution for real-time data stream processing.
premises.evidence_span: we provide a cloud-based platform for software developers that makes it easy to do two key things, to take large streams of data that are in flight real-time and to process them.

premises.text: Real-time data processing can enhance audience engagement during live events.
premises.evidence_span: the result is a whole new dimension to television, giving you an unprecedented insight into the sentiment of the audience in real time.

premises.text: Social television represents a significant opportunity for audience interaction.
premises.evidence_span: social TV is a huge opportunity.

premises.text: The Bright Context platform can handle large volumes of real-time data efficiently.
premises.evidence_span: this is a hard problem. This is the problem the Bright Context Platform solves.

premises.text: The platform lowers the barrier to entry for developers to use sophisticated back-end technology.
premises.evidence_span: we're dramatically lowering the barrier to entry to very sophisticated back end technology.

premises.text: The platform supports various applications beyond social television, including business metrics and gaming.
premises.evidence_span: our platform, of course, is applicable in a lot of other ways, a lot of other use cases.

value.text: Developers can create innovative applications using real-time data processing.
value.evidence_span: I challenge you to build the next great app on our platform.
